outcome: Cardiac complications of labor and delivery
cohort: Pregnant women hospitalized for delivery (vaginal or cesarean) in the USA from 2003-2012, including 82 with Ebstein anomaly and 7,850,299 without
finding: Pregnant women with Ebstein anomaly are at higher risk of major adverse cardiac events (MACE) during pregnancy and delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery occurred more frequently among the Ebstein anomaly cohort compared to those without (47.6% vs 31.1%, P≤0.001).
